name: They Came from the Pipes
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, manifest dread twice. (To manifest dread, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever a face-down creature you control enters, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: When this enchantment enters, manifest dread twice. (To manifest dread, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever a face-down creature you control enters, draw a card.

needs.what: Manifest dread (701.62): look at the top two cards of your library, choose one to put onto the battlefield face down as a manifested 2/2 creature (turnable face up for its mana cost if a creature card), and put the other into your graveyard; repeatable via amount ("twice" performs the whole look-choose-manifest-bin sequence two separate times)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `manifest` op carries only amount, cloak and player and manifests the top card blind with no look-at-two choice or graveyard half; `look_at_top` has `face_down` but the engine honours it only for exile destinations (ops_cards.py), so it cannot put a chosen card onto the battlefield as a manifested 2/2

needs.what: A trigger filter key (e.g. `face_down: true`) on `permanent_enters` matching a creature that enters the battlefield face down (manifested, cloaked, manifested dread or morphed)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `trigger_filter_keys` has controller, types, is_token etc. but nothing reading the 707 face-down state, so `permanent_enters` with controller you and types Creature would also draw for every face-up creature
